title: Word 3 — On Our Adoption by God
attribution_note: Word 3 of 28 in the collection Short Moral-Instructive Words — see Word 1 for provenance.

pairs.en: O goodness! O love of God for mankind! O how greatly God's love has prevailed! O how abundantly God's grace has overflowed! Poor, rejected sinners have been made children of God! The apostle of Christ marvels at this and says: *“See what love the Father has given us, that we should be called and should be children of God.”* What could be more astonishing than for a sinner to become a child of God? God's love for man has brought this about. What could be more glorious than to be called, and to be, a child of God? God's grace has granted this to man. It is glorious to be the child of an earthly king, but incomparably more glorious to be the child of God, the King of Heaven. This honor, glory, dignity, nobility, and name surpasses beyond compare every title this world has to offer. Glory be to God, the Lover of Mankind, for this!

And if Christians are children of God, then they are also heirs: *“heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ”* [Romans 8:17]. If they are children of God, whom and what should they fear? Why fear slanderers, enemies, the devil, demons, death, and hell? God stands for them: *“If God is for us, who can be against us?”* [Romans 8:31]. We receive this supreme gift of God in Baptism, for it is then that we are born of God and receive this most glorious title.

sections.heading: Called to bear the family likeness

pairs.en: Beloved Christians! Let us remember holy Baptism and the supreme mercy God showed us then. In that hour we became children of God. Glory to God for this! But of children it is required that they resemble their parents: *“That which is born of the flesh is flesh, and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit”* [John 3:6]. Therefore Christians, too, being born of God, ought to be conformed to God's likeness. Let us show by our deeds, then, that we are children of God.

sections.heading: Living out the likeness of the Father

pairs.en: God is holy — let us also be holy. God is righteous — let us also be righteous. God is good, *“for He makes His sun rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust”* [Matthew 5:45] — let us also be good, and do good to friends and enemies alike, to those who love us and to those who hate us. God is merciful — let us also be merciful, and show mercy to our brothers and sisters in need. God hates sin — let us also hate every sin and turn away from all sin. God loves us — let us also love one another. God forgives our sins when we repent — let us also forgive the sins of others.

To this the apostle of Christ calls us: *“Be imitators of God, as beloved children”* [Ephesians 5:1]. If we show forth such a character in ourselves, we shall be true children of God, and shall receive the inheritance and all the blessings promised to the children of God in Christ Jesus our Lord. Amen.
